capabilities: Replace the selected text with the clipboard contents
Copy the replaced selection back to the clipboard
Run the swap from the Command Palette or an assigned hotkey
Restore the original clipboard if editor replacement fails
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says it is pending acceptance into the community directory.
motivation: Designed for revision workflows where you already have a replacement on the clipboard and want the old wording available immediately afterward.
problem: Replacing selected text with clipboard content normally requires a manual delete/paste cycle or a temporary note to keep the old wording available.
summary: Clipboard swap plugin that replaces the current text selection with the clipboard contents in one command, keeping the old wording on the clipboard.
